settings.title: Homes sold by people who know the street

settings.editor: Hartwell & Rowe is an independent agency in the Old Town. We sell about ninety homes a year, and a partner handles every one from valuation to keys.

settings.title: One partner, from the first visit to the day you move

settings.editor: You will not be passed to a junior after signing. The person who values your home shows it, negotiates for it and telephones you every Friday, whether there is news or not.

icon_list.text: A measured plan and proper photographs for every home
Viewings shown by the partner, not a key-holder
One fee, agreed in writing, paid on completion
